cause: The visual path called World.step(render=True) every nominal 2 ms torque update while rendering_dt was 20 ms. The local Isaac SimulationContext implementation uses app.update() for this call, coupling physics progression to the rendering interval. Headless step(render=False) advances a single physics step.
fix: Always step physics with render=False, render separately at 50 Hz, and verify each torque update advances exactly 2 ms of physics.
